method: On the gateway host, through the installed client_adapter_smartx: every distinct last4 on firm 49financial's accounts in the newest non-empty account map, grouped by the module's own _candidates_by_account; each candidate's account_id joined to its allocations and their roster rows, each advisor_name mapped through the context's own firm_roster(); a master_admin stand-in, read-only, audit sink stubbed.
denominator: 6010 SmartX candidates (distinct account_ids of the firm, over 4528 distinct last4 values), built from 10193 firm allocations of 10268 roster rows and 7650 account-map rows; the advisor-to-firm map holds 3 names over 3 firms.
note: 0 of 6010 candidates have an advisor mapped to another firm; 0 have an unmapped advisor, 0 an allocation without a roster row, 0 sit on an account that also carries an allocation outside the firm's set; the served tool and the module agreed on 6 of 6 last4 values checked. The live commit is the deployed artifact's git-ref, equal before and after the read; host bytes were not walked. BOUND: 75 of the 10268 roster rows carry an advisor name the map does not hold; the adapter drops them and attributes them to no firm, so they are outside n and this count cannot speak for them.
